Title: 5th Grade Overnight Trip Informational Session
Description: Please join us for an in person session to learn more about the goals, logistics, and highlights of the upcoming 5th Grade Outdoor Education trip. We'll share key details about the schedule, safety, and what students can expect, and there will be time for Q&A at the end. This is a great opportunity to get your questions answered and hear how this experience supports student growth, teamwork, and connection. We hope to see you there!

Title: The Great Kindness Challenge Week Begins
Description: Internationally, students participate in this week designed to highlight the importance of kindness. While being kind to ourselves and others matters all of the time, this is a week to do things that make a difference through expressing gratitude, helping others, taking care of the environment, and more.

Title: Fall Cabaret
Description: The Annual World AIDS Day Cabaret will be presented by the GDS Cabaret Club on Friday night. Approximately 35 students will participate and there will be 15-20 musical acts over the course of 90 minutes. The Internet Cafe area will be set up with tables of food and treats, and people are encouraged to arrive by 6:30 so that they can get food and sit back to enjoy the show. Admission is $5 for students and $10 for adults. GDS staff receive one complimentary ticket.

Title: Hopper Fund: Learn and Play
Description: Lower School Hopper Fund Ambassadors invite fellow lower school families to join them for play, bagels, coffee and answers to all of your Hopper Fund questions.

Title: Welcome to GDS Party for Parents/Guardians of Students New to GDS
Description: Parents/Guardians of students new to GDS are invited to join us for this reception. Meet fellow parents/guardians, PSA Co-Chairs, Board Members, and members of the school leadership.

Title: Parent Connect: Guest Speaker, Author Katherine Reynolds Lewis
Description: Join us as we welcome back author, parenting expert and parent of alumni Katherine Reynolds Lewis to talk more about "The Good News about Bad Behavior." Katherine spoke to parents and guardians last year and we're inviting her to continue the conversation. Come to hear more about effective parenting, be encouraged, and learn strategies to improve your connection with your children/teens.

Title: High School Jazz and Creative Music Concert
[PSA] Thanksgiving Bag Packing & Pie Collection
Description: Come to GDS and help pack Thanksgiving grocery bags for Bread for the City and pack up and decorate donated pies for DC Central Kitchen. This GDS tradition is fun for the whole family.

Title: Parent Connect: Raising Kids Who Can
Parent Connect: for Adoptive Parents
Description:
Join the counselors and Debbie Riley, LCMFT, and CEO at the Center for Adoption Support and Education during National Adoption Awareness Month. Debbie and a panel of adult adoptees will share experiences and offer support for adoptive parents. Families and student support team members from other nearby independent schools are also invited.

Please contact Meryl Heyliger with questions: mheyliger@gds.org

Title: Parent Connect: Puberty Isn't Spooky (4th grade Puberty Curriculum)
Description:
Please join us for an event for parents and guardians to learn more about the 4th grade puberty curriculum from the Health & Wellness team.

Questions? Email Catilin Hutcheon chutcheon@gds.org

Title: Parent Connect: Dr. Ryan DeLapp
Description:
Join the counselors as we welcome Dr. Ryan DeLapp, Psychologist, Author and Director of the REACH Program at the Ross Center. Dr. DeLapp will talk about ways to support children and teens in  building confidence with and navigating peer interactions across differences, and healing from and guarding themselves against negative peer messages.

Please contact Meryl Heyliger with questions. mheyliger@gds.org

Title: Parent Connect with Student Support Services
Description:
Please join us for the first of our regular opportunities to connect and engage around a variety of topics. 
All parents and guardians from every division are invited to attend and interact with other parents/guardians, counselors, and learning specialists. We look forward to talking about the start of the year and your hopes for your children/teens.

Please contact Meryl Heyliger, Counseling Department Chair, at mheyliger@gds.org.

Title: High School Homecoming Dance
Description: High School students are invited to the first dance of the year. Join us for the HS homecoming dance following Sports Saturday.

Title: Middle School Curriculum Night
Description: All middle school parents are invited to meet their child's teachers and learn more about our academic programming. At this back-to-school night, parents can get a snapshot of their child's school day experience. Light refreshments will be served starting at 6:00 with formal programming beginning at 6:30 pm.
